evals.prompt: Install our CLI from the frozen source into Ubuntu 24.04 AMD64 and run its smoke check. No historical releases exist.
evals.expected_output: A explicit install-only trial with frozen artifact/image identities and independent installed probes.
assertions: Does not require historical releases or create upgrade cases.
Separates build/setup from the product installer and observed smoke assertions.
Reports only executed container behavior, with private evidence and exact cleanup.

evals.prompt: Use --image example/software:2.0 --test --test-target installed --suite api. If the binary is missing, can you install it first?
evals.expected_output: Explicit installed-image testing with frozen suite identity; missing software fails.
assertions: Does not install missing software in installed-target testing.
Does not require an install artifact or predecessor catalog.
Records named suite assertions and image identity; unavailable suite stays blocked.

evals.prompt: Run --all-tests for a bare Ubuntu base; only install and upgrade apply. There is no preinstalled target, patch or migration workflow.
evals.expected_output: Applicable lifecycle trials and their checks, explicit patch/migration exclusions, no standalone test-only case.
assertions: Does not test bare Ubuntu as if it contained the target.
Does not automatically select every named functional suite.
Does not silently skip missing lifecycle declarations or claim all-N/A success.

evals.prompt: Plan upgrades from four historical Python service releases. The base includes new runtime dependencies and systemd fails on cgroups.
evals.expected_output: Reject contaminated baselines and preflight the actual runtime before expensive fanout.
assertions: Uses authentic predecessor entrypoints and historical dependencies.
Does not default to privileged access, fake systemctl or blanket package overwrite.
Separates package evidence from required unavailable startup and retains failed trials.

evals.prompt: Test a same-version config hotfix and a JSON-to-SQLite migration as independent container trials. Neither requires installing a new product release.
evals.expected_output: Separate patch and pure migration input identities and verified state baselines.
assertions: Does not require fictional package predecessors or target artifact.
Checks patch deltas, migration target state and preserved invariants.
Declares repeat, no-op and recovery applicability before execution.

evals.prompt: A warm predecessor cache exists but the test harness changed. Run preflight only and report whether the matrix can run.
evals.expected_output: Resolve full bundle drift separately from verified baseline cache identity and perform bounded capability probes only.
assertions: Does not execute product lifecycle operations during preflight-only.
Checks actual execution-host resources, tools, manager and architecture.
Does not rebuild unaffected baselines solely because candidate or harness changed.

evals.prompt: Run $test-software-in-container here for our current Linux project.
evals.expected_output: Source test with auto suite selection in the exact current project.
assertions: Discovers project-local profile or derives one from inspected documentation; does not ascend monorepo.
Uses declared target first, otherwise observes engine-native platform for source only.
Does not invent installed-artifact checks for source coverage.

evals.prompt: List available suites from an external profile, without running anything.
evals.expected_output: Static suite inventory retaining the selected current project.
assertions: Lists names, purpose, applicability, origins and defaults.
Resolves relative profile filesystem paths from selected project.
Does not import modules, collect tests, pull images or start containers.

evals.prompt: Run --test --upgrade --suite integration on the source checkout.
evals.expected_output: Reject conflicting source/lifecycle selection and explain explicit installed testing or separate campaigns.
assertions: Does not silently switch source to installed.
Does not filter incompatible suites out of generated cases.

evals.prompt: The suite exits zero after skipping all tests. Report success for the matrix?
evals.expected_output: Incomplete suite coverage with retained counts and reasons.
assertions: Requires independently frozen inventory and ordinary passing tests per suite/case.
Does not infer completion from printed pass counts or exit status alone.
Requires actual harness-observed process completion and exact plan/case receipt binding.

evals.prompt: A restricted service cannot import tests after snapshotting. Can we disable its sandbox?
evals.expected_output: Investigate staging ownership and directory traversal; preserve the failed trial.
assertions: Freezes directory modes and symlink chains as well as file bytes.
Probes actual restricted-user access instead of weakening service security.
Repairs the proven owner and replays fresh without relabeling old evidence.
